thread:
samir: Quick check — Tenant-42 private rollout: where are we on egress/NAT and air-gap blockers? Need an updated list before tomorrow's sync.

lena: NAT gateway provisioned in staging, still pending prod CIDR assignment from NetOps. I filed netops ticket #NET-914.

derek: Confirming firewall rules: we've added ALLOW 10.128.0.0/14 -> 0.0.0.0/0 on the tenant router for outbound, but we need the approved egress IP range to lock it down.

maya: Also flag: image sync to the airgapped bootstrap registry failed last night — digest mismatch on redwood/runtime:2.3.1. I retried and it got stuck at 60%. Logs: 
```
ERROR: blob checksum mismatch for layer sha256:ab12... retrying
curl: (18) transfer closed with pending read
```

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Staging deploy for tenant-42 succeeded (tags: v2.3.1). Canary 3/3 healthy.

nico: @maya on the digest mismatch — can you paste the output of `skopeo inspect docker://registry.internal/redwood/runtime:2.3.1` and `sha256sum` of the file in the airgap staging bucket? I synced a local copy and it matched my sha256.

maya: pasted results to NET-914 but copying here: `skopeo` shows sha256:ab12cd34ef56, bucket file shows sha256:ab12cd34ef56, but the registry returned ab12cd34ef57 during pull. Looks like the registry manifest got re-pushed mid-sync.

rachel: That can happen when CI retriggers a publish. Ops should enforce immutability on the registry tags during cutover windows. We don't have that set for tenant-42 window.

samir: Action items so far: (1) NetOps assign prod egress range (NET-914) — @lena to chase. (2) Enforce tag immutability for cutover window — @rachel to open infra ticket. (3) Image sync retry with manifest lock — @maya to re-run after infra change.

lena: chasing NetOps now. ETA 4 hours. Will post CIDR when approved.

nico: On egress, note that the customer's environment requires SNI passthrough for third-party telemetry (splunk.example.net). We need to make sure the egress proxy preserves SNI — current squid config uses `ssl_bump none` for passthrough which should be fine, but I'll validate in staging.

rachel: Infra ticket INF-2043 created: "Registry tag immutability for private-rollouts" — assigned to @ops. Adding rollback plan: if immutability can't be set in time, we'll coordinate a short freeze window and pause CI pushes.

maya: Re-run started: `./scripts/airgap-sync --tenant 42 --image redwood/runtime:2.3.1 --retry 5` — streaming logs look clean so far.

derek: On firewall and monitoring: please add a healthcheck to egress path — `curl -I https://splunk.example.net/health` via the tenant NAT and post results. If SNI passthrough fails it'll 403/SSL error.

samir: @derek can you own the egress healthcheck automation? If it fails, we should fail the rollout gating job.

ops-bot: alert: uptime-prober detected TLS handshake error from tenant-42 egress probe at 1747655600 — code TLS_ALERT_UNKNOWN_CA.

nico: That TLS alert is probably because the customer's egress proxy is intercepting with their CA. We need to ensure monitoring trusts their CA for probing or use a probe endpoint that responds without TLS interception.

rachel: Added to INF-2043: add option to trust customer CA in prober container.

lena: NetOps update: allocated egress IPs 54.223.11.128/28 for tenant-42. Please update firewall to restrict outbound to that range and update NAT translation.

derek: Roger. I'll push a rule change and schedule a 5-min maintenance window. Will post `iptables` diff after.

maya: airgap sync finished successfully after retry. Manifest lock avoided the race. All images present in the bootstrap registry.

samir: Nice. Remaining blockers?

nico: Need one more validation: confirm prober can reach splunk endpoint with SNI passthrough (no MITM). If NetOps egress preserves SNI, we good.

rachel: Also confirm audit logs are flowing from tenant-42 into our central S3 — sometimes airgapped setups misroute the audit forwarder.

lena: NetOps confirmed SNI passthrough preserved. They tested with `openssl s_client -servername splunk.example.net -connect 52.14.200.22:443` and server cert chain was intact.

derek: iptables change applied. Diff: 
```
-A OUTPUT -d 0.0.0.0/0 -j ACCEPT
+A OUTPUT -d 54.223.11.128/28 -j ACCEPT
```

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Prod NAT update applied for tenant-42 at 1747657200.

samir: OK — checklist for tomorrow's handoff: (a) NetOps CIDR applied (done), (b) Registry immutability or CI freeze (INF-2043), (c) Airgap images verified (done), (d) Egress prober passing (pending final run), (e) Audit logs confirm-forwarding (pending).

maya: I'll run prober once more after Derek's changes and post status in this thread.

nico: I'll validate Splunk access and post sample prober headers.

rachel: I'll add a note to the runbook about the manifest race and add rollback steps.

samir: Great — if we get the prober green in the next 2 hrs I think we can sign off. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

maya: Prober final run: PASS 200 OK at 1747657820 — headers show SNI preserved.

samir: Signed off. Closing thread after the post-flight tomorrow.
